card.name: Digit before 8 in numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, mostly 6 (sometimes 1), that comes just before an 8 or 4. It is typically the 6 in 68°F (20°C to 25°C room temperature) or a figure inside a ratio or verse reference.

modes.label: 68°F in room temperature
modes.description: The 6 that starts 68°F after a Celsius range of 20 to 25.
modes.example: or at room temperature of 20°C to 25°C (<<6>>8°F to 77°F)

modes.label: Other numbers ending in 8 or 4
modes.description: A first digit in a count, weight or Bible verse, where the next digit is 8 or 4.

card.plain: It fires on the leading digit of a number, most often the 6 in 68°F in storage temperature ranges.
